hotels.title: 5-Star Uluru Glamping with All-Inclusive Dining, Drinks & Airport Transfers
hotels.description: Marvel at the majestic beauty of Uluru with a once-in-a-lifetime stay at the spectacular Longitude 131°. Nestled among the rich red dunes of Uluru-Kata Tjuta National Park, Longitude 131° is a bucket-list destination, a safari-style luxe retreat promising guests an unforgettable escape amid the impressive outback scenery. Engage in a unique Australian dining experience with a stunning desert backdrop, and explore the natural wonders of the Northern Territory. Each intimate tent and pavilion offers expansive, uninterrupted views of Uluru and Kata Tjuta; a truly unparalleled opportunity to connect with Australia's gorgeous Red Centre.

hotels.title: Outback Bestseller Returns! Iconic Uluṟu Retreat with Daily Breakfast & Field of Light Experience
hotels.description: A mirage of sail-shaped awnings signals your arrival at this five-star outback retreat, your gateway to exploring Uluṟu, Kata Tjuṯa and the awe-inspiring landscapes of Australia's Red Centre as you delve into Australia’s roots at Voyages Ayers Rock Resort. Watch as darkness gives way to soft light and colour at the 10th anniversary of Bruce Munro’s Field of Light Uluṟu installation or find a secluded sand dune to watch the sun set below Uluṟu - a moment of stillness in one of the world’s most extraordinary landscapes. Your included Star Pass is the ultimate way to celebrate the famed installation’s anniversary, with chef-crafted canapes paired with wine, beer and non-alcoholic drinks. When you’re not staring in wonder at the Field of Light, listen to stories of Aboriginal culture during a ‘Bush Yarns’ session, tour the Gallery of Central Australia and view some of the hundreds of artworks it houses, or take a guided garden walk highlighting the seasonal flora, bush foods and trees native to the region. A member of the Journey Beyond collection, Sails in the Desert weaves Indigenous design and outback character into every corner. Between experiences, retreat from the heat with a dip in the gumtree-lined pool, hit the Piṟa Pool Bar or linger over native-infused Australian cuisine at Ilkaṟi Restaurant.
